label: About this page
bullets: The Versance web app mock-up ("Talk to Edgar"): a white 230px sidebar with a New button and pill nav items, a main area with the hero, the composer and cards
Single self-contained file: one <style> block, inline SVG logo and favicon, one script; Figtree and Roboto Mono load from Google Fonts
The :root block holds the light palette (white, #D9DDE5 lines, green #5AC47E accent, amber #E2B43D); a second :root holds the dark theme

label: Tokens
bullets: Part of the Versance token set: the :root blocks of this file (light, dark media query, data-theme dark and light) are generated from design-tokens/tokens.css through design-tokens/map.json (python3 tools/build_tokens.py); edit values in tokens.css, not here
Source type colours: filing #2B40C5, news #E2B43D, transcript #334EFE, web #65728E, ask/compare #5AC47E, create #E2B43D
